about: Standing work queues for the other AIs (owner 2026-10-08: 'share workload with Grok; when it completes a task give it another; there should always be something for all other agents to work on'). Claude keeps every active queue at 3 or more open tasks and refreshes it at every intake. Each AI works top to bottom: when one task is done it writes DONE and the date under it in its Drive queue doc (or says so in chat) and starts the next one without waiting. Rendered by tools/agents/render_queues.py into docs/agents/QUEUE_{agent}.md, the agent's Drive doc and the fix list.

agents.name: Grok
agents.strength: Strongest outside contributor (10/10 last review): web + Drive access, opens Numista, careful sources.
agents.reach: Drive doc 'WORK QUEUE for Grok' in Titan Reliquary/ + this repo (raw GitHub URLs)

tasks.title: Numista sweep, batches 1 to 9

tasks.title: Check and improve the classical recordings
tasks.what: Read docs/music/intake_report.json (what the intake job picked from Wikimedia Commons for each piece and why). For every pick, open the Commons page and confirm: real performer (not MIDI or synth), right piece, license Public Domain / CC0 / CC BY(-SA). For any piece with no pick or a weak one, find a better recording (Commons, Musopen, archive.org) with its license page. Write the result as a JSON list {id, file (exact Commons title) or url, license, performer, why} in Drive 'music-requests (Grok)' as music_grok_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json.
tasks.done_when: One JSON file covering all 24 pieces in docs/music/wanted.json.
